design_philosophy: Layered darkness replacing flat black. Tonal boundaries instead of borders where possible, mixed with crisp 'Technical Grid' elements for data density. Typography scales aggressively to help field workers quickly parse information on mobile.

mobile_first_rules: Use fixed bottom sheets or large full-width buttons for primary actions on mobile
Hide secondary tabular data columns on mobile

buttons.primary: rounded-lg px-6 py-3 bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-medium hover:bg-primary/90 active:scale-[0.98] transition-transform
buttons.secondary: rounded-lg px-6 py-3 bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground font-medium hover:bg-secondary/80 transition-colors
buttons.ghost: rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-text-secondary hover:text-text-primary hover:bg-surface_elevated transition-colors

inputs.default: w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-background px-4 py-3 text-base text-text-primary placeholder:text-text-disabled focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary outline-none transition-all

cards.dashboard_widget: bg-surface border border-border rounded-xl p-6 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-300
cards.job_card: relative overflow-hidden bg-surface border border-border rounded-xl p-5 border-l-4 border-l-primary

tables.header: bg-surface_elevated text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-text-secondary py-3 px-4

badges.status_active: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-status-success/10 text-status-success border border-status-success/20
badges.status_pending: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-status-warning/10 text-status-warning border border-status-warning/20

login_background.description: Dark geometric texture for the login split screen background

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react date-fns react-hook-form @hookform/resolvers zod lucide-react`
Map the provided colors to Tailwind CSS variables in index.css (using --background, --foreground, --card, etc.) ensuring a dark mode default.

MUST use `data-testid` attributes on ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, list items, dialog triggers) using kebab-case and role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`, `data-testid='job-card-link'`).
Build the Auth flow with static dummy states (Login/Signup/Forgot Password) and include an 'Admin Test Account' fast-login button.
Implement the Dashboard showing 'Jobs Today', 'Jobs This Week', and 'Quick Actions' in a mobile-friendly grid.
Implement Client Management with a list view and add/edit forms.
Implement Jobs Management with create/edit forms, start/complete flows, job type dropdowns, and recurring/one-off options.
Implement Quotes flow allowing contractors to create quotes with customer name, address, price, notes, and status.
Implement Invoices flow: auto-create draft invoice on job completion. Calculate and display totals with 15% GST by default (for NZ), and invoice status.
Implement Plans View showing 'Solo' and 'Solo+' as active/usable, and 'Team' and 'Pro' greyed out with a 'coming soon' badge.
Use generous padding inside cards (`p-6` or `p-8`) to maintain E1's required visual density and breathing room.
For header/navigation, use glassmorphism effects (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-surface/80`) and ensure links are easily accessible on mobile via bottom tabs or an off-canvas menu.
Ensure all components are thoroughly responsive, focusing on mobile-first for contractors working in the field.
